policy.files: For each of8 rate/carrier groups, original and matching mark through both codecs. Decode first exact2seconds at original native rate, preserve stereo,bind file/decoded sample hashes and actual stream timing. AAC encoder delay is decoded by ffmpeg,not treated as a forged offset.
policy.scope: Authored mathematical carriers and native Tensor/file contract,not human speech/provider export accuracy,not lip-sync or video marking.
policy.upstream: Pinned inspected AST definitions only; omit upstream create/weight-loader/package/file-decode entry points. Reuse exact hash-matching restricted-loaded16-bit generator/detector weights.
policy.parity: Each native detector response compared to independent channel-presence and exact integer binomial-bit arithmetic. First generator and detector input repeat bitwise. Stereo channels remain separate mono batch items; no resampling in marker.
policy.meaning: Upstream audio detected is family presence,not a payload test. The returned payload field is the baked expected payload,not recovered bits. Matching public marks are copyable and cannot authenticate AI origin or stop detection.
policy.missing: Preserve all80 planned cases and errors. Missing/unavailable checks are not negative or original. No inference from absent marks.
